jobs.description: The Senior Associate – Regulatory CMC, Biocides/Pesticides/Topicals/Collars, works cross functionally with Elanco R&D groups, manufacturing and quality to develop global regulatory strategy, authors submissions, oversees submission preparation and meets the reporting requirements for the Authorization and Maintenance of registrations of new animal drugs with global regulatory agencies. Biocides/Pesticides.Your Responsibilities:- Proven track record of overseeing end to end life cycle management (LCM) of pharmaceutical dosage forms e.g., otic solutions/suspensions, spot-on solutions, pour-on solutions/suspensions and collars- Design/develop CMC regulatory strategy for geo-expansion of marketed products with a focus on creativity and innovation, maximizing the business benefit interdisciplinary project teams, while applying the global strategy into submissions.- Ensure the required documentation and any content, quality and/or timelines for global submissions are communicated to the appropriate teams and tracked according to the functional procedures- Author high-quality CMC documentation for submission, applying CMC global regulatory strategies and assuring regulatory compliance and provide training and mentorship to CMC team members, as necessaryWhat You Need to Succeed:- Degree in Science (MSc, B.Pharm/M.Pharm, Postgraduate in Vet Sciences etc.,)- Min. 5 years in Global Regulatory Affairs, CMC (hands on experience with the Registration process of a variety of pharmaceutical dosage forms is desirable)- Strong knowledge of FDA (CVM), EPA, EMA and ICH/VICH guidelines and regulations governing the authorization and post approval compliance of biocides/pesticides and topical products intended for veterinary use.- Experience in developing CMC Diese Rolle richtet sich an eine zertifizierte Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit, die Freude daran hat, internationale Arbeitswelten sicherer zu machen und als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen US‑amerikanischen Exchange‑Strukturen und deutschen/europäischen Arbeitsschutzvorgaben zu agieren.Ihre Aufgaben- Beratung im Arbeitsschutz — Sie unterstützen das Exchange Europe Occupational Health and Safety Program bei der Einhaltung deutscher und europäischer Sicherheitsgesetze und setzen die internen Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien um.- Interpretation und Anwendung von Standards — Sie übertragen nationale Vorschriften sowie OSHA‑Standards in die Exchange‑Strukturen und begleiten deren Umsetzung.- Fachliche Betreuung von Sicherheitsprogrammen — Sie überwachen Programme der industriellen Sicherheit und Präventivmedizin und stellen sicher, dass lokale Sicherheitsstandards in Prozesse und Anweisungen integriert werden.- Zusammenarbeit mit Behörden — Sie pflegen enge Kontakte zu Sicherheitsbehörden, Feuerwehren und Präventionsstellen und fördern die Kooperation in allen sicherheitsrelevanten Bereichen.- Durchführung von Inspektionen — Sie prüfen Einrichtungen, Arbeitsplätze, ergonomische Bedingungen, Arbeitsprozesse und technische Anlagen.- Unfallanalyse — Sie untersuchen Vorfälle, erstellen Berichte und leiten Maßnahmen ab.- Schulungen & Führung — Sie führen Trainings durch und übernehmen die fachliche Leitung von Mitarbeitenden.Ihr Profil- Zertifizierung als Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit nach deutschem Recht- Mindestens 2 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung- Fundierte Kenntnisse im deutschen/europäischen Arbeits- und Gesundheitsschutzrecht- Führerschein Klasse B und Bereitschaft zu Reisetätigkeit- Ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und SchriftHinweis: Die Stelle kann auf der Ebene C‑7a besetzt werden, wenn die Qualifikationen noch nicht vollständig erfüllt sind.Schwerbehinderte Bewerberinnen und Bewerber oder Bewerberinnen und Bewerber mit gleichgestelltem Status werden bei gleicher Qualifikation bevorzugt berücksichtigt.++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++The Exchange is part of the U.S. Armed Forces. As a retail organization, the Exchange provides soldiers, civilians, and their family members with all the shopping opportunities they are familiar with from home. In addition to stores offering clothing and everyday necessities, AAFES also operates branded restaurants, movie theaters, and more. The organization also includes a large vehicle fleet, a distribution center, and a bakery.Serves as an Occupational Health & Safety Advisor for the Exchange in Germany.Position incumbent works under general supervision of the Regional Loss Prevention Manager and assists in providing support to the Exchange Europe Occupational Health and Safety Program in complying with host nation safety laws. Complies with Exchange Occupational Health and Safety policies, directives, and regulations.Performs as advisor, technical consultant and coordinator in the application of host nation safety laws and their integration into the Exchange Europe Occupational Health and Safety Program. Interprets safety policies and standards, to include OSHA, for application. Assists with implementation and enforcement of standards. Provides professional guidance on safety requirements.Provides oversight of the Industrial Safety & Preventive Medicine Programs. Assists in ensuring host country safety practices and standards are incorporated into operating procedures, directives, and instructions.Establishes and maintains close liaison with various safety agencies to ensure cooperation with fleet safety, fire protection and prevention, accident prevention, and other matters of concern. Performs plan reviews, conducts compliance inspections to include facilities, equipment, ergonomics and work processes. Advises on the layout of workplaces, processes, and work environment. Recommends corrective actions.Analyzes accidents, conducts investigations, prepares reports and recommendations.May be required to conduct training. Supervises subordinate personnel.MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:Must be certified to act as an Occupational Safety and Health Specialist (Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit) under German law plus a minimum of 2 years’ related work experience. Knowledge of worker-safety provisions of the German/European Labor Safety and Occupational Health laws and rules.Preferred related work experience in the retail field.Position involves travel; driver’s license Class B is required.LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT:Position requires an excellent command of both written and oral English and German language.* Note: Position may be filled at C-7a level if qualifications are not fully met yet.Severely handicapped applicants, or applicants of the same status with the same qualifications, will be given preferential consideration.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Lärmschutz, Fachtheoretische Unterweisung, GefahrenanalyseExpertenkenntnisse: ErgonomieZwingend erforderlich: Arbeitsmedizin, Arbeitsschutz, Unfallverhütung, Arbeitsplatzanalyse, Arbeitsplatzgestaltung

Focused among other on development, leadership, appreciation ... it´s time to upskill your career.- Support with individual solutions: we are people-caring!We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey.Want to know more about all our benefits? Discover more here (https://metro.digital/about/life-at-metro) .Let´s connect soon. Apply for the role now!Position grade within our career framework: Technical Architect Grade 1 (Md8).

The Leibniz-Institut für Analytische Wissenschaften - ISAS - e. V. develops efficient analytical methods for health research. Thus, it contributes to the improvement of the prevention, early diagnosis, and therapy of diseases like cardiovascular diseases or cancer. Overall, the institute strives to advance precision medicine by combining knowledge from different fields such as biology, chemistry, computer science, medicine, pharmacology, and physics. ISAS is a member of the Leibniz Association and is publicly funded by the Federal Republic of Germany and its federal states.We invite applications for the Research Group Biofluorescence: PhD candidate (f/m/d)This project, funded by the DFG as part of CRC 1752, "DYNAMO: Immediate Tumor Dynamics in Melanoma Therapy“ (https://www.uni-due.de/crc1752/) seeks to combine high-resolution multi-omics profiling, advanced computational modeling, and clinically aligned biomarker stratification, in order to generate actionable, patient-specific predictions and resistance-targeting interventions in melanoma therapy. You will be responsible for finding out the role of neutrophils for the early development of therapy resistance in human melanoma. The project is being carried out in collaboration with University Hospital Essen and the University of Duisburg-Essen.You will be responsible for- Experimental setup and execution of neutrophil functional profiling in the context of melanoma immune regulation and immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) response- Functional assays of neutrophils including migration, phagocytosis, and ROS production- Optimization and standardization of neutrophil functional assays for primary human samples- Few-cell proteomics for deep molecular characterization of neutrophil subsets- Multicolor flow cytometry of PBMCs and immune cell populations- Live-cell imaging and advanced microscopy for dynamic immune cell behavior analysis- Planning and execution of stimulation and inhibition experiments to dissect signaling pathways regulating neutrophil function in the melanoma context- Data processing, analysis, interpretation, and visualization of experimental results in collaboration with computational partnersYour profile- Completed diploma or master’s degree in molecular biology, cancer biology, immunology, cell biology, bioinformatics, translational medicine or related disciplines- Experience in molecular and cellular biology techniques, ideally with hands-on experience with functional immune cell assays (preferably with neutrophils or myeloid cells) is an advantage- Strong interest in melanoma biology, tumor immunology, immune checkpoint therapy, translational cancer research, and tumor–immune interactions- Experience with cell culture, flow cytometry, microscopy, proteomics workflows or high-dimensional immune profiling approaches is desirable- Experience with bioinformatics or biostatistics is beneficial but not required- Ability to work independently and in interdisciplinary teams, with strong organizational skills and analytical thinking- High level of self-motivation, scientific curiosity, reliability, creativity, and team-oriented personality with enthusiasm to work in a collaborative research environment- Fluent in spoken and written EnglishWe offer- A clear research topic as well as multifold training and support for PhD students in framework of ISAS and the Leibniz association- Opportunities for scientific training and development in an international environment and an excellent working atmosphere in a very dynamic and professional team- Access to state-of-the-art technologies including few-cell proteomics, high-dimensional flow cytometry, and advanced microscopy platforms- Integration into an interdisciplinary, internationally visible, translation-oriented cancer immunology research network- The opportunity to present your data on international conferences and participate in workshops- A wide range of opportunities for further training and qualifications- Flexible working times, mobile working and attractive social benefits- Family-friendly infrastructure and support from a family serviceNon-residents who apply for this job will receive help from the institute to find accommodation and to handle authorities. Applications from disabled applicants are welcome. ISAS supports the principle of equal opportunity for all employees and therefore particularly encourages women to apply.The part-time position (65%) starts on October 1, 2026, and is offered until June 30, 2030. The salary will be according to the German TV-L and falls within the pay group 13. The time limitation of the contract is based on the Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz (WissZeitVG).ISAS collects and processes the personal data of its applicants in accordance with European and German legal regulations. Further information on data protection and the processing of personal data can be found at: https://www.isas.de/en/datenschutz.The closing date for applications is** August 14, 2026**. Please apply via our applicant portal (https://bewerbermanagement.net/en/jobposting/4e342c0b4ebdda805ec07aefc033c1e6bce0d9010/apply?ref=Agentur+f%C3%BCr+Arbeit+Dortmund) . If you have any questions (reference number 411_2026), feel free to contact the Human Resources team (bewerbungen@isas.de). Further information about the institute can be found at: https://www.isas.de/en.

The University Hospital Bonn (UKB) is one of Germany’s leading university hospitals, combining top-level performance in medicine and research with excellence in teaching. Each year, more than half a million patients receive inpatient and outpatient care at the UKB. Around 3,500 students study medicine and dentistry here, and over 600 people are trained annually in healthcare professions. With approximately 9,900 employees, the UKB is the third-largest employer in the Bonn/Rhein-Sieg region. In the Focus hospital ranking, the UKB ranks first among university hospitals in North Rhine-Westphalia and second nationwide in terms of case mix index (case severity). In 2024, the UKB raised nearly €100 million in third-party funding for research, development, and teaching. The F.A.Z. At Sumary, we are rebuilding finance from first principles. In short, we are creating the AI operating system for accounting work. Founded in 2025, Sumary is already used by some of the largest accounting firms in the world, including Deloitte, Grant Thornton and Baker Tilly, and the products we ship will define how finance teams work in the coming decade.

We have raised $29m, including the largest seed round ever in the Nordics, from Singular, byFounders, Partech and Tenity, and angels including Tuomas Artman (Linear), Morten Primdahl (Zendesk), Steve Anavi (Qonto), Stanislas Polu (Dust), Steffen Tjerrild (Synthesia), Jannick Malling (Public) and Ben Freeman (Omnea).

Our engineers are also our product managers and designers. You talk to customers, understand their pain points, design the best solution and ship it to a standard that sets the bar for the industry. You are confident owning features end to end, from the data model to the last pixel of the interface.

AI writes most of our code, so producing code is no longer the bottleneck. Judgment is: deciding what is worth building, and making it excellent. Just because something takes half a day to build doesn't mean it should exist.

We are a small team of full-stack generalists, TypeScript end to end, and product comes first in everything we build. What unites us is a deep care for craft, fast execution and the discipline to say no. We are looking for experienced engineers who thrive on autonomy and individual responsibility.

We have offices in Copenhagen and London. Copenhagen is our engineering hub, and this role is based there.

**Come help define and build the future of finance.

**What you'll do

• Work closely with founders and customers, and turn what you hear into the right solution, which is often not the one they asked for

• Build new user-facing features end to end, with beautiful and scalable UI components

• Obsessively improve performance, so every interaction feels instant, even for our largest accounting firms

• Use what you built the way a customer would, and polish it until it is right before it ships

• Delete by default: push back on scope, on features we shouldn't build and on anything that feels off

• When an agent gets something wrong, fix the tooling so it doesn't happen again for anyone

What we're looking for

• 5+ years building customer-facing products at a company known for the quality of its software

• Deep fluency in TypeScript and React, and confidence across the full stack: Node.js, Postgres and the data model underneath

• Product obsession and a good eye for design: you care about UX, speed and polish. You notice the slow interaction, the awkward empty state and the setting nobody needs, and you fix them without being asked

• A track record of shipping complete features end to end, not only incremental work

• Comfort working without a product manager. You would rather talk to the customer yourself

• High ownership: you take a problem from start to finish and care about how it lands

• You know the difference between extra effort and meaningful quality

• You build AI-first, directing agents through the implementation while you own the judgment

Nice to have

• Experience as one of the first engineers at a startup that went on to scale

• Interfaces you designed yourself, not only built

• Experience with financial and ledger data

Our stack

TypeScript end to end: React and Next.js, Node.js, Postgres and Supabase, Temporal, Modal and our AI service layers. We don't expect you to have used all of it.

Applying

Along with your CV, send us something you built that you are proud of, and one thing in a product you use every day that you would fix.

Strategic Procurement Specialist – Indirect Goods & Services

Do you find motivation in building value through teamwork, strategic sourcing, and productive supplier partnerships? Would you like to help shape procurement decisions across Nordic retail organizations and contribute to a more efficient and sustainable business? Then keep reading.

As our new Procurement Specialist, Indirect Goods & Services (IGS), you will play an important role in developing category plans, managing sourcing projects, and partnering with colleagues across the Nordic markets to identify opportunities and deliver value.

As a member of our Indirect Goods & Services (IGS) team, you will report to the Head of Procurement, Nonfood and contribute to advancing the IGS agenda throughout the Nordics.

**What you'll be doing

**

In this role, you will:

• Develop and execute category plans and sourcing strategies across assigned indirect goods and services categories

• Deliver cost savings, working capital improvements, and other value-creation initiatives

• Manage end-to-end sourcing projects, including analysis, tender management, supplier selection, negotiation, and implementation

• Negotiate and manage commercial agreements while ensuring compliance with procurement governance and policies

• Build and maintain positive supplier relationships, promoting performance, innovation, and continuous improvement

• Provide strategic procurement support and advisory to internal stakeholders across the Nordic organizations

• Utilize market insights, benchmarking, and data analysis to support decision-making and identify new opportunities

• Support process enhancements and contribute to the continued evolution of procurement tools and best practices

**What we're looking for

**

We know that great candidates do not always meet every requirement, but we imagine that you bring:

• 1-5 years of experience within procurement, strategic sourcing, category management, or a related commercial discipline

• Experience managing supplier relationships and commercial negotiations

• Solid analytical skills and the ability to turn insights into practical recommendations

• Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders in a changing business environment

• Knowledge of procurement processes, sourcing methodologies, and contract management

• Experience working with data, Excel, and procurement-related systems

• Interest in IT/AI is an advantage, but not a requirement

• Professional proficiency in English and at least one Nordic language

**Who you are

**

You enjoy working with people and building relationships across different functions and cultures. You combine strategic thinking with a practical approach and are at ease working through both complexity and change.

You are likely someone who:

• Communicates clearly and builds trust with colleagues and partners

• Takes initiative and follows through on commitments

• Collaborates effectively across teams and markets

• Is curious, methodical, and open to new perspectives

• Stays organized while managing multiple priorities

• Approaches challenges with a positive and solution-oriented mindset

• Works well both on your own and as part of a team

• Seeks opportunities to improve processes and ways of working

**What we offer

**

At Coop Trading, you'll be part of an international and collaborative environment where you can help shape decisions and contribute to meaningful business results.

We offer:

• An exciting role with broad exposure across the Nordic markets

• The opportunity to shape sourcing strategies and procurement initiatives

• Collaboration with experienced colleagues and stakeholders across four countries

• Professional and personal development opportunities

• A culture built on trust, teamwork, learning, and continuous improvement

• Flexibility and support for a healthy work-life balance

Workplace: Our office is located at Skelbækgade 2, 1717 Copenhagen V.

We believe that a positive culture is built through spending time together. Our Vesterbro office is therefore our primary place of work, while we offer the flexibility to work from home when needed.

The role includes approximately 20-35 travel days per year, including occasional overnight stays.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Head of Procurement, Nonfood Michael Bjunes at +45 2777 2432.

If you are ready to join Coop Trading's Procurement team, please send us your application and CV no later than 27th of November 2026. We review applications on an on-going basis.

Coop Trading is a dynamic, responsible, and ambitious workplace. We are 140 dedicated professionals in Denmark and in Spain, as well as a network of trusted partners across the Nordic region. We work to challenge the status quo delivering the best and most innovative private brand products.

A cornerstone of our identity is our continuous commitment to fostering an engaging and appreciative work environment and to being an exceptional place to work.

We want to create equal opportunities for everyone and ensure an efficient and fair recruitment process. It is therefore up to you whether you wish to attach an application letter and a photo.

Coop Trading is developing and sourcing products to make the everyday life better for 27 millon Nordic consumers by leading Nordic private brands: Xtra, Coop, and Anglamark.

jobs.occupation: Power System Engineer for Dynamics, Modelling and Control; DK - Fredericia
jobs.description:
The Danish power system is changing rapidly as wind, solar, batteries, power electronics and international connections play an increasingly important role. This creates new dynamic behaviour and calls for better models, analysis methods and engineering tools. As our new Power System Engineer, you help us understand these changes and turn complex analyses into practical solutions. You also help develop and maintain the simulation environment that supports our stability studies and engineering decisions.

“We are looking for someone who enjoys building models and tools while keeping sight of the physical power-system problem they are intended to solve. A structured approach to maintenance, quality and processes is just as important as developing new solutions.”
– Laurids Dall, Manager

Join an international team of power-system specialists
At our head office in Fredericia you join a highly specialised and international team working with power-system dynamics, stability and power quality. We support system operation, contribute to major technical projects and identify the capabilities the future power system will need. Close technical collaboration is an important part of our work, and we therefore expect you to work from the office at least two days a week.

Shape the tools behind a stable power system and enhance our simulation environment

Your tasks depend on your experience and the projects you join. You will typically:

• Perform dynamic stability studies and identify present and future system needs.
• Develop and validate dynamic models and analysis methods.
• Develop, maintain and quality-assure our simulation environment, primarily using DIgSILENT PowerFactory and PSCAD.
• Automate simulations, screening and analysis workflows.
• Translate technical findings into recommendations for system design and operation.
The job combines power-system engineering with structured development and maintenance. You help ensure that models, processes and results are documented, reproducible and suitable for reuse across the organisation. 

Within your first 6–12 months, we expect you to have:

• Contributed professionally to stability studies or model-development activities.
• Understood the structure and purpose of our simulation environment.
• Improved at least one model, workflow or quality-assurance process.
• Turned analysis results into clear technical conclusions.
• Build effective working relationships within the team and across Energinet.
Combine technical curiosity with a structured approach

You have a MSc in electrical engineering or a related field. Your academic or professional background may include electrical power systems, power-system dynamics, power electronics, converter control or electrical energy systems. You may be a recent graduate or have a few years of relevant experience. We do not expect you to know every part of the field from day one. What matters is your technical foundation, willingness to learn and ability to approach complex engineering problems systematically. 

You check off one or more of the qualifications we are looking for:

• Dynamic modelling and stability analysis in DIgSILENT PowerFactory or PSCAD/EMTDC
• RMS or EMT simulation
• Programming, scripting or automated engineering workflows
• Model validation, documentation and quality assurance
• Version control or collaborative software-development practices
Often the problems we work with do not have a predefined solution. You should therefore enjoy investigating complex technical questions, challenging assumptions and developing new approaches together with others. You will thrive in the role if you:

• Are curious and want to understand why a system behaves as it does.
• Enjoy building models and tools while keeping sight of the problem they are intended to solve.
• Can structure complex problems, turn analysis into practical conclusions and take responsibility for progressing your own work.
• Enjoy collaborating and sharing knowledge with other specialists as well as communicating complex topics to colleagues with different technical backgrounds.
Will you make a difference with us?

We look forward to receiving your motivated CV no later than 20 December. You may want to pencil in a couple of dates in your calendar already. We expect the first interview to take place online on 5 January and the second interview in Fredericia on 11 January.
If you have questions about the job, please contact Manager Laurids Dall on
tel. +45 3092 3194.

Special conditions: As Energinet performs tasks critical to society, we carry out background checks prior to employment. Employment is conditional upon your background check being compatible with employment at Energinet. The background check is also carried out once a year.
The position also requires that you are able to obtain and maintain security clearance. On PET's website, you can read more about security clearance.

We see diversity as a strength and encourage all qualified people, regardless of background, to apply for the job. We work actively and determinedly with diversity in Energinet and therefore encourage you to exclude information about age, marital status, etc. to minimise outage biases in the process. You can read more about our diversity policy here.

Energinet Systemsansvar's core tasks are to integrate renewable energy, ensure equal access to the grids, develop market design, monitor, and balance the transmission grid and ensure security of supply in Denmark. We are a subsidiary of the Energinet Group, which represents the interests of society when supplying Denmark with electricity and gas and that the energy system is converted to green energy. Our culture is closely linked to our social responsibility, and we work actively with the UN's global goals on sustainable energy, climate action, partnerships for action as well as industry, innovation, and infrastructure. By leading the way in the green transition, we can help to solve the global climate challenge. New solutions require us to be able to see problems from many different angles, and diversity is therefore a keyword in our culture. We strive to listen to, involve and share our knowledge. Based on the values of courage and trust, we focus on constantly developing ourselves as an organisation and as people. Read more at our website www.energinet.dk.

Help us build a secure, efficient and user-friendly digital workplace! We are looking for a Microsoft 365 & Modern Workplace Specialist to join our IT Operations & Security team.

European Energy is a growing company within renewable energy. We develop, construct, and operate projects within solar (PV) and wind farms globally, as well as Power-to-X. Our core values are the foundation of everything we do_: In it together, Trust and courage, Ambition, Excitement, Inclusion,_ and Agility.

Your New Role

As our new Microsoft 365 & Modern Workplace Specialist, you will play a central role in managing, developing, and continuously improving our Microsoft 365 ecosystem and modern workplace platform. Working across Microsoft Intune, Windows endpoint management, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, Exchange Online, and Microsoft Entra ID, you will help deliver a secure, efficient, and user-focused digital workplace.

This is a hands-on position for a technically strong professional who combines excellent administration and troubleshooting skills with a focus on governance, security, and continuous improvement.

Your New Team

You will be joining the IT Operations team which currently consists of 10 people responsible for the overall security, architecture and operations of network and server infrastructure, storage and application landscape incl. the M365 suite.

We are well supported by our 6 colleagues in IT support with whom we have strong collaboration.

Areas of Responsibilities

• 
Package, deploy and maintain applications, administer and continuously improve Microsoft Intune.

• 
Manage Windows 11 device configuration and policies.

• 
Support the complete lifecycle of corporate devices, from provisioning and enrolment through operation and retirement using Windows Autopilot and modern device provisioning.

• 
Administer, maintain and further develop SharePoint Online, support the design and governance of sites, permissions, document libraries, metadata and information architecture.

• 
Support users and business functions in getting more value from SharePoint, Microsoft Teams and OneDrive while maintaining standards and best practices for usage across the organization.

• 
Work with Microsoft 365 Groups and understand the relationship between Groups, Teams, SharePoint and other Microsoft 365 services.

• 
Support information protection, governance and compliance capabilities within Microsoft Purview.

• 
Manage configuration, policies, permissions and governance across relevant Microsoft services.

• 
Use PowerShell and Microsoft Graph for administration, troubleshooting and automation.

• 
Work with colleagues across IT to troubleshoot issues that cross traditional boundaries between devices, identity, security and Microsoft 365.

Your Profile

• We imagine that you have several years of experience working with Microsoft 365, Modern Workplace or endpoint management in an enterprise or larger organizational environment.

• You have practical experience with Microsoft technologies and understand how devices, identities, applications, collaboration services and security controls work together as part of a modern workplace.

• You have deeper expertise in certain areas, such as Intune and endpoint management, Microsoft 365 administration, or SharePoint and collaboration, but you are comfortable working across the broader Microsoft ecosystem and developing your expertise over time.

• We do not expect you to be an expert in every area. Strong practical experience in one or more core Modern Workplace technologies, combined with broad Microsoft 365 and endpoint management knowledge, is more important than expertise in every individual product.

As a person, you

• Enjoy taking ownership of technology and improving it over time.

• Can troubleshoot technical issues methodically and follow them through to resolution in collaboration with colleagues across IT and the wider organization.

• Can translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and are comfortable communicating technical topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Have a security-conscious mindset and consider security as part of how solutions are designed and operated.

• Are pragmatic and comfortable working in an environment where technologies and priorities continuously evolve.

We Offer

• A broad and varied role with the opportunity to develop deep expertise across Microsoft Intune, Windows endpoint management, Microsoft Entra ID, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, Exchange Online, and Microsoft 365 administration, security, and governance.

• The opportunity to work across the full Modern Workplace ecosystem, gaining end-to-end exposure and influencing a wide range of Microsoft 365 services and technologies.

• A collaborative IT Operations & Security environment where your work has a direct impact on delivering a secure, stable, scalable, and user-friendly digital workplace.

• A position in a dynamic and growing renewable energy company, where technology plays a key role in supporting the green transition.

• A supportive, ambitious, and international team culture that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development.

• An attractive benefits package, including flexible working arrangements, a company phone and laptop for private use, six weeks of paid annual leave, a subsidized breakfast and lunch scheme, employee discounts, access to fitness facilities, and a dedicated professional development budget with access to training and language courses.

European Energy at a glance – The Power of Tomorrow, Today

We are now more than 890 employees with 50 nationalities represented in 21 countries, and we are growing rapidly in both Copenhagen and across our global offices. We all work for our common goal to be a leading partner in the green transition and to create The Power of Tomorrow, Today.

Our working environment is built on mutual respect for the varied strengths and talents of our employees, with a flat hierarchy and a culture that encourages initiative and innovation. Our employees value our flexible working culture, permitting better reconciliation of work and personal life. At European Energy, you will work with colleagues from around the world and become part of a collaborative international network.

We lead with purpose. At European Energy, our leadership culture is built on six guiding principles that shape how we collaborate, make decisions, and grow together. These principles help us act responsibly and empower each other to succeed.
